title: Tales of Terror and Mystery
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: "Tales of Terror and Mystery" by Arthur Conan Doyle is a collection of short stories written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: Explore Detective and mystery stories, English, Horror tales, English. This complete source edition preserves the original text and its period language, with the edition credits and licence included.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

authorInfo.bio: Arthur Conan Doyle was a Scottish-born physician and author who created Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson. His detective stories made close observation central to the mystery genre. Beyond Holmes, he wrote historical fiction and adventure stories, including The Lost World.
authorInfo.edition: Complete collection of twelve stories. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.

editionCredits: Produced by Charles Keller. HTML version by Al Haines.

rightsReview.policy: Source states US public domain; listed creative contributors died by 1945. Unknown dates excluded. This is a screening record, not a legal certification.
